description: Check a plan in one pass without returning a drawing (parse, resolve and lint): the gate a plan passes before it ships. `strict:true` makes advisory warnings fail too. Optional `graph` checks the plan's interior-door adjacency against an intended room graph (`{ room: [neighbours] }`); a mismatch fails. Optional `intent` (a brief's expectations, shaped as the `archlang://intent-schema` resource describes) is checked against the plan: a missed gating assertion (room count, existence, area, total area, windows) fails, while adjacency and reachability are advisory and only score. `profile` lints under a named ruleset as well, and its warnings are the ones reported; `taste` scores the plan under a taste profile, which never fails it. `next` is the one item to fix first, chosen in a fixed order (an error, a compile warning, a validity warning, a drafting warning, the brief and the graph, a profile-only warning, then the lowest taste score), or null when nothing is left; a broken `soft` keep is not weighed here yet, so where the CLI's `validate` names it this returns a later item, or null. A malformed intent returns `{ ok:false, intentErrors }` and an unknown profile `{ ok:false, error }` as data, never an exception. Returns { ok, diagnostics, graph?, intent?, next }.

intent.description: A brief's intent JSON (shape: the archlang://intent-schema resource); gating assertions fail.

profile.description: Advisory lint ruleset to report under ("residential-basic", "accessibility-advisory", …); default: the built-in ruleset.

taste.description: Taste profile that ranks `next`'s taste tier (for example "generic"); it never fails the plan.

name: validate
title: Validate (parse + resolve + lint)
